title: Na Nammakam – Benny Joshua Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీకే నా ఆరాధన – నిన్నే నే ఘనపరచెదన్
నీకే నా ఆరాధన – నిన్నే నే ఘనపరచెదన్
english: Neeke naa aaraadhanaa – ninne ne ghanaparachedhan
Neeke naa aaraadhanaa – ninne ne ghanaparachedhan
intro: Na Nammakam is the latest Telugu Christian song translated from popular Tamil Christian song, Neer Vazhgavae released on February 11, 2023. This song was written, tuned and sung by Tamil Christian Gospel Singer, Pastor Benny Joshua and music composed by Stanley Stephen. This song was released on January 20, 2024 through Benny Joshua Ministries YouTube channel.
